name: Master Lock Safety Series S806 3' Steel Cable Lockout
description: Cable lockout; safety hasp; 5/32" (4mm) diameter x 3' (91.4cm); multi-stranded steel cable; insulated with plastic coating; Zenex thermoplastic body; performs effectively in extreme conditions (-50° F to +300° F (-46°C to 149°C)); high-visibility, re-usable, write-on safety labels (English, French & Spanish).
